daily.title: Stale branch cleaner for git

daily.problem: Repos pile up hundreds of old branches and nobody knows which are safe to delete.
daily.whoPays: Developers on busy repos; teams for a shared cleanup policy.
daily.pricing: Free and open source; $29 per seat per year for team policies.
mvp: List branches merged into main or untouched for 30+ days
Interactive checklist to pick what to delete
Dry run, plus undo from a saved list
Works on local and remote branches
